subtitle: Lesson 22 · Working With APIs in Python

code:
import requests

response = requests.get("https://api.github.com")
print(response.status_code)
print(type(response))
# 200
# <class 'requests.models.Response'>
caption: requests.get() returns a Response object, not raw text.

code:
print(response.status_code)   # 200
print(response.text[:60])     # raw body, as a string
print(response.headers["content-type"])
# application/json; charset=utf-8
caption: status_code, text, and headers cover most of what you'll read.
.json() turns the body straight into a Python dict or list.
